summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a Form 6-K updating its share buyback programme. The company announced a second tranche of up to $500M, completing a total $1B return to shareholders. The programme is executed on both US and London trading venues via Goldman Sachs as riskless principal. Shares purchased will be cancelled. The second tranche runs from July 6 to December 18, 2026, with up to $130M allocated to London. The maximum shares purchasable is 42,289,442. This is a structured capital return, not an opportunistic repurchase. Watch for execution pace and any acceleration.
